_note: The title screen's PERSISTINT letters (scripts/ui/title_letters.gd). The author's own lines (2026-10-24), not quotes. Each letter jiggles to the title theme's beat (bpm; beat phase from Music's playback position); a tap makes it jiggle harder, pop hearts and say a line. Taps add to a counter that decays back toward the giggles ('decay_per_second'); 'tiers' pick the letters' line by the counter ('min' = the lowest count the tier covers; lines rotate within a tier); a tier with 'sulk_seconds' makes the letters droop and ignore taps that long. 'chime_ins' are other speakers who step in once each time the counter crosses their 'min' (and again once it has decayed below and crossed again). Speakers are Voice speaker ids: 'letters' = silverman (Sarah Silverman clone), 'reason' = warren (Elizabeth Warren), 'last_word' = richter (Andy Richter); clips come from the voice pipeline, TTS until then.
